queries:
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH f AS (
    SELECT account_id, amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM f)) AS ratio
FROM f
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
